intentAssessments.title: Replace the latest preview instead of appending another preview
intentAssessments.expected: For an ARM API with stable versions followed by a preview, adapt and rename the latest preview to the new preview; additions in that active preview use the corresponding @added version.
intentAssessments.actual: Versions retains 2025-01-15-preview and appends 2026-08-01-preview, while the new overage model and properties are introduced with @added(v2026_08_01_preview).
intentAssessments.rationale: The additions are version-scoped, but the preview-after-preview guidance requires replacing the latest preview member when stable versions already exist. Retaining both preview members does not follow the prescribed version evolution pattern.
intentAssessments.gap: The additions are version-scoped, but the preview-after-preview guidance requires replacing the latest preview member when stable versions already exist. Retaining both preview members does not follow the prescribed version evolution pattern.
